title: Panda reading a book
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Panda body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- Panda head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="22" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="24" r="8" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="24" r="8" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="40" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="40" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="39" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="39" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#aaccff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#aaccff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 53 Q50 57 54 53" stroke="#4a4a6a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="68" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#4a4a6a" transform="rotate(-20 30 68)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="68" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#4a4a6a" transform="rotate(20 70 68)"/>
  <!-- Book left page -->
  <path d="M28 60 L50 58 L50 82 L28 80 Z" fill="#ffd966"/>
  <!-- Book right page -->
  <path d="M50 58 L72 60 L72 80 L50 82 Z" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1="50" y1="57" x2="50" y2="82" stroke="#e6a800" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Text lines on left page -->
  <line x1="33" y1="65" x2="46" y2="64" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="69" x2="46" y2="68" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="33" y1="73" x2="46" y2="72" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Text lines on right page -->
  <line x1="54" y1="64" x2="67" y2="65" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="68" x2="67" y2="69" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="72" x2="67" y2="73" stroke="#b8860b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Book cover edge bottom -->
  <path d="M28 80 L50 82 L72 80" stroke="#cc8800" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="92" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="92" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
</svg>
